overview: This table holds the translated music track names shown in the collection and free battle menu.
description: Localized display labels for BGM tracks. All 28 exported rows in every language use BGM_* keys and localized track-number text (English 'Track 01'..'Track 28'); Bgm.Id_SoundText points here for sound-collection titles and battle-BGM options.

ID.simple: Pick the music track this label belongs to, like menu or battle music. This name links it to the music and free battle choice.
ID.technical: FName ID (+0x0) of FGameDataTableRow_GameText. Runtime lookup calls UDataTable::FindRow(TextId), so it matches the DataTable row name; the export's ID field duplicates that row name in all 11 shards but is not itself the key used by FindRow. FGameDataTableRow_Bgm::Id_SoundText stores the same string; UGameCollectionSoundListItem::GetTitleTextId returns it (NAME_None when BgmRow is null), and the free-battle rule screen adds Row->Id_SoundText.ToString() as an option with SetUseTextId(true). SoundTextDataTable_<Language> is candidate position 12 (zero-based; 13th of 14) in StartLanguageLoading/Tick, with only non-null loaded tables appended. PlayBgm(FName("BGM_MENU")) and similar calls use the same strings as cue-sheet/playback names; GameSoundManager::PlayBgm itself neither reads this text table nor looks up BgmDataTable.

Text.simple: Players see this track name for unlocked music in the collection and free battle options. Locked music uses a different message instead.
Text.technical: FString row text (+0x10). UGameWidgetTextBlock::SetTextIdOnly builds a request and calls AGameTextManager::GetText; a UGameWidgetTextOptionBox with bUseTextId converts each option string to an FName and takes the same path. For non-SYS_ ids GetGameText finds the first matching row name in TextDataTables and returns Row->Text after FormatText parameter/glossary substitution; a missing row or empty Text yields an empty string. All 11 export shards have 28 rows with nonempty Text and identical row names/IDs; En values are 'Track 01'..'Track 28' in row order and contain no format tags. Locked collection entries substitute SYS_STORY_CORRELATION_DIAGRAM_LABEL_1003 instead of this text. Bgm CueSheetName/Duration drive audio/slider behavior, not this label.

notes: FGameDataTableRow_GameText has 11 exported language variants (28 rows each) and an empty reconstructed constructor (FName NAME_None / FString empty defaults); every exported row name equals its ID field, and all 28 SoundText keys are referenced by BgmDataTable Id_SoundText.

Load/chunk: StartLanguageLoading builds <Base>_<Language> primary-asset loader names and Tick rebuilds TextDataTables from 14 candidate tables; SoundTextDataTable_<Language> is zero-based slot 12 and non-null tables are appended in order. Config/DefaultGame.ini:35-45 maps En/Ja/Fr/Es/De/It/Ko/Zh_Hant/Zh_Hans/Pt/Es_LA to ChunkId 1-11; UAbramsAssetManager::DoesPrimaryAssetMatchCustomOverride uses case-insensitive EndsWith, so those suffixes do not overlap.

Name roles: BgmDataTable row ID/Id_SoundText/CueSheetName and all 28 SoundText row names are the same BGM_* strings in the exports. Playback call sites pass those strings to GameSoundManager::PlayBgm, which loads a cue sheet by that FName; free-battle and collection-title paths convert Id_SoundText into a GameText lookup. A PlayBgm call does not read SoundTextDataTable.

Lookup precedence/aliases: GetText branches only on a case-insensitive SYS_ prefix; all other ids are searched in TextDataTables order and the first row found wins. No exact BGM_* row-name collision exists among the exported GameText tables (BgmDataTable has the same names but lives in a different table array), and there is no resolved-string cache: FindRow/GetRows search the live tables on each call.

Consumer conditions: collection item titles use Bgm.Id_SoundText only when bUnlocked; locked entries use SYS_STORY_CORRELATION_DIAGRAM_LABEL_1003; GetTitleTextId returns NAME_None without a BgmRow. Free battle uses only Bgm rows whose Id contains 'BATTLE' (11 exported rows), appends a Random option, sets bUseTextId, and selects by Settings.BgmId (the Bgm row ID) rather than Id_SoundText; in the exports those strings match.

Reconstruction status: FindTextRow 0x14af290 and AGameTextManager::Tick 0x14c96f0 are behavioural, not byte-identical (BEHAV NA15 and BG03 respectively); GetGameText 0x14af510, GetText 0x14afde0 and StartLanguageLoading 0x14b5a90 are byte MATCH, though 0x14b5a90 carries a ZB02 behaviour-diverges marker for a contested call. Widget and manager behavior here is reconstructed C++; no retail Blueprint property/binding evidence was reviewed.

usages.detail: Returns BgmRow->Id_SoundText as the collection item's title text id, or NAME_None when there is no BgmRow.
Uses that title id only for unlocked entries; locked entries instead display SYS_STORY_CORRELATION_DIAGRAM_LABEL_1003.
Adds battle Bgm rows' Id_SoundText values plus a Random option, enables text-id display, then selects by Settings.BgmId (the Bgm row ID, equal to Id_SoundText in the exports).
With bUseTextId enabled, converts an option string such as BGM_BATTLE_01 back into an FName text id for the option box's text block.
Resolves a text-id request through AGameTextManager::GetText before displaying it.
Loads SoundTextDataTable_<Language> into the 14-table TextDataTables candidate list used for non-SYS_ lookups.
Finds the first GameText row with the requested name and formats its Text for GetGameText/GetText.
DTM_CollectBattleBgmRows filters Bgm rows whose Id contains 'BATTLE', constraining which Id_SoundText values reach the free-battle option box.
